
// code to make test cases:
        int size = 250;
        vector<vector<int>> board(size, vector<int>(size));

        cout << "[\n";

        for (int row = 0; row < size; ++row)
        {
            cout << "[";

            for (int col = 0; col < size; ++col)
            {
                board[row][col] = (row + col) % 2;

                cout << board[row][col];

                if (col < size-1)
                    cout << ",";
            }

            cout << "]";

            if (row < size-1)
                cout << ",";

            cout << "\n";
        }

        cout << "]" << endl;
